svg.title: Fig. 205(c) — Violin
svg.desc: Redrawn from Robert C. Yates, A Handbook on Curves and Their Properties (1947), Fig. 205(c), page 231. Section: trigonometric.

g.data-text: The wave repeats every period 2π; five and a half periods are shown.
The sum of the harmonics sin(nt + φn), n = 1…5, with the amplitudes 1, 0.45, 0.35, 0.15, 0.10: each period rises with a shoulder to a peak and falls steeply.
